element_formulation: Standard Abaqus CPS4R (3,814 quads) + CPS3 (109 tris), plane-stress
loading: 2-step displacement control: Step 1 to uy=1.0 mm (2000 incs), Step 2 to uy=1.5 mm (2500 incs), total 4,500 increments

f1693_case_a_baseline.description: F1693 Case A Intact Linear-Elastic Recovery (CPE4/CPE3, uy = 1.46 mm)

criterion_a.requirement: secondary corridor max MISESERI >= 30% of field peak

criterion_c.requirement: continuous elevated-error band along both branches against Fig. 15a experimental path on Fig. 15b scale
criterion_c.observation: Secondary corridor remains at low far-field background error (< 5.5% of peak); no continuous band exists along right ligament

predeclared_band_criteria_evaluation.scientific_conclusion: Band is ABSENT. Hypothesis H1 is FALSIFIED for the standard-element plane-stress formulation. Standard plane stress (CPS4R) yields virtually identical relative error distributions to Case A plane strain (CPE4) with secondary corridor error remaining under 5.5% of notch peak across all load states.
